hints.title: Subarray Minimum Criterion
hints.text: Every element in a subarray of length k exceeds threshold / k if and only if the minimum element in that subarray exceeds threshold / k.

hints.title: Maximal Boundary for Minimum
hints.text: For each element, determine the largest subarray [left, right] where this element is strictly the minimum.

hints.title: Span Evaluation
hints.text: Use next and previous smaller element boundaries. If nums[i] * (right - left - 1) > threshold, then length k = right - left - 1 is a valid solution.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Span Implementation

complexity.notes: Each index is pushed and popped from the monotonic stack at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(n^2) subarrays takes O(n^3) or O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores left and right boundary arrays of size n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Connects the condition min(subarray) * k > threshold to monotonic stack maximal subarray span calculation.
